communication-blocks-scheduler.note: The inherited article used unsupported switching and time-savings figures, rigid message schedules, and fabricated observations. The effective public record is narrowed to a role-aware batching workflow: map actual response obligations, batch only routine traffic that can wait, preserve a clear escalation path, convert substantial requests into tasks, and revise the schedule when it harms delivery or coordination.

if-then-rules-productivity.note: The inherited article mixed effect-size claims and fabricated outcomes with health-adjacent triggers, wearable thresholds, and rigid repetition rules. The effective public record is narrowed to ordinary low-stakes work decisions: recognize one observable cue, pre-decide one safe action, add a common fallback, and revise or retire the rule when context changes.

top-3-daily-focus-planner.note: The inherited article contained fabricated completion samples, unsupported habit and estimation claims, universal time budgets, and fixed scheduling prescriptions. The effective public record treats up to three outcomes as a visible capacity boundary rather than an optimal number: scan obligations, choose a small outcome set, define done, park the rest visibly, and re-plan explicitly when urgent work changes the day.

default-choice-audit.note: The inherited article contained unsupported uptake effects, invented interruption savings and annualized impact, fabricated personal observations, arbitrary review cadences, and overgeneralized conclusions. The effective public record is a bounded default-choice audit: inspect consequential defaults, state the requirement first, compare realistic alternatives and switching costs, keep or change deliberately, and record rollback when it matters.
